synths.notes: Deterministic stand-in used by the fake runtime. Never shipped in an image; approved because it is our own code under the repository license.

First-proof default. Ships in-tree with Ardour 9.7 and needs no soundfont, so the acceptance path carries no unresolved sound-library question. Per-plugin license text has not yet been read; identity comes from the libs/plugins listing.

Available but not the acceptance-path synth. Requires an approved SF2 whose identity and redistribution status are both unresolved; soundfont licensing is a common source of redistribution problems, so the first proof deliberately avoids it.
